_doc: Madone landmark truth: video second at which the camera passes the landmark (read from frames, FINDINGS 'Timing in town'). lon/lat = the point of the decoded centre line of work/menton_local/out at the arc used by work/fable_timing/eval_lm.py; the arcs after 2440 s were defined on an earlier path and are approximate (a few metres).
_doc_gotthard-start: Gotthard start checkpoints (score 'checkpoints': distance of the route at second t to the point, hit within tol_m). t = video second of the passage read from frames at 1 s spacing (the clip has the same timestamps as the source video); lat/lon = OSM nodes of alps.osm.pbf (junction node, bridge or tunnel midpoint, roundabout centre). Tolerance 50 m at sharp junctions in town, 100 m where the point or the second is less sharp (car park, open road). The wrong alternative (Umfahrungsstrasse bypass) is 300-700 m from checkpoints 1-5.
